criteria.requirement: A useful procedural L bracket includes a bolt hole and overhang in a visible 220x220x250mm build volume.
criteria.action: Inspect the initial part and build-volume outline.
criteria.expected: An L-shaped bracket with bolt hole and overhang sits in a visible 220x220x250mm volume.

criteria.requirement: Local ASCII and binary STL imports treat coordinates as millimeters and reject unreadable files without losing the current part.
criteria.action: Import valid ASCII and binary STL fixtures, then an unreadable file.
criteria.expected: Coordinates are treated as millimeters and unreadable input reports an error without replacing the current part.

criteria.requirement: Orbit/front/side/top inspection and transformed width/depth/height agree with scale and orientation.
criteria.action: Switch orbit/front/side/top views after transforming the part.
criteria.expected: Displayed width/depth/height match the transformed geometry and camera views.

criteria.requirement: Numeric/quarter-turn axis rotations, uniform scale, bed translation and Place on bed preserve independent camera/object state and place the lowest point at bed height.
criteria.action: Rotate on each axis, scale uniformly, translate on the bed and use Place on bed; move the camera separately.
criteria.expected: Object transforms apply, the lowest point rests at bed height, and camera navigation does not change object coordinates.

criteria.requirement: Outside-volume portions and downward-facing overhangs are identified with an adjustable documented angle convention excluding bed-resting faces.
criteria.action: Place geometry outside the volume and vary the overhang threshold.
criteria.expected: Outside portions and downward overhangs highlight according to the disclosed angle convention, excluding bed-resting faces.

criteria.requirement: A horizontal section plane exposes a cross-section while preserving part orientation.
criteria.action: Move the horizontal section plane through the part.
criteria.expected: Cross-section and height update while the chosen object orientation is preserved.

criteria.requirement: STL export bakes current scale/rotation/placement; reimport reproduces geometry/dimensions, and reset restores the initially loaded part.
criteria.action: Export a transformed STL, reimport it and reset.
criteria.expected: Exported geometry includes scale/rotation/placement, reimport reproduces dimensions, and reset restores the initially loaded part.

criteria.requirement: File processing stays in the browser; slicing, generated supports and printer communication are outside scope. Unobservable implementation details must remain unverified.
criteria.action: Import and export with external services unavailable, inspecting relevant browser network activity where accessible.
criteria.expected: File handling works locally; hidden implementation facts remain unverified and slicer/support/printer features are not required.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the sample bracket, dimensions, build limits and overhang-angle explanation.
Rotate/scale/place the part, compare views, force a volume violation and inspect section heights.
Import small ASCII/binary STL fixtures, reject a malformed fixture, export/reimport a transformed part and compare dimensions before reset.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
